# Extra Time Coaching (also known as Extra Time Football)

> Independent, 1 star England Football accredited football coaching for U13–U15 girls who play grassroots football, in Bingley and Keighley, West Yorkshire. Small groups, individual development, coached by an FA accredited coach and club welfare officer.

Extra Time Coaching is not a competitive team or a replacement for club football. Players stay with their own grassroots club and can attend whichever club they play for. Prices and dates change, so please use the linked pages for current details.

## Pages
- [Home](https://extratimecoaching.com/): overview, current sessions, enquiry form
- [Bingley Development Centre](https://extratimecoaching.com/bingley-girls-football-development.html): weekly term-time U13–U15 girls sessions at Beckfoot School, Bingley
- [Christmas holiday camp](https://extratimecoaching.com/girls-football-holiday-camp-keighley.html): indoor 3G holiday camp at Marley Activities and Coaching Centre, Keighley
- [Team wear](https://extratimecoaching.com/team-wear.html): optional Joma tees and quarter zip, fits, size guides and how orders work
- [FAQs](https://extratimecoaching.com/faqs.html): who the sessions are for, group sizes, safeguarding, insurance, costs and payments
- [Privacy and cookies](https://extratimecoaching.com/privacy.html)

## Key facts
- Location: Beckfoot School, Wagon Lane, Bingley, BD16 1EE (weekly sessions); Marley Activities and Coaching Centre, Aireworth Road, Keighley, BD21 4DB (holiday camp)
- Coach and club welfare officer: Jonathan Gallucci, FA accredited coach
- Safeguarding: DBS checked, qualified coaches; players insured; 1 star England Football accredited club
- To ask about places, availability, 1-to-1 coaching or team wear, use the enquiry form: https://extratimecoaching.com/#enquiry
